"UtilEs — ETECSA utilities for Cuba.
Development and design: Luis Esteban G. (lestebang11@gmail.com)
Built with Jetpack Compose on the Jetpack Android Starter template by Atick Faisal.
Thanks to the Cuban community of testers and users for their reports and suggestions.
Brand logos are property of their respective owners."

"UtilEs works entirely on your device and does not collect, store or share personal data on external servers.
• SMS, call log and contacts permissions are used only to show your own history and statistics inside the app. That information never leaves your phone.
• Your Nauta credentials are stored locally on your device and are sent only to the official ETECSA portal (secure.etecsa.net) when you log in.
• USSD codes are dialed directly against the ETECSA network; the app only reads the responses to display them.
• The app does not include ads and does not sell data to third parties.
By using UtilEs you accept this policy. If you have questions, write to lestebang11@gmail.com."
This service may have a cost. Do you want to continue with \"%1$s\"?

"• Check your main balance anytime with *222# from the Home screen.
• In Registro you can filter plan purchases and transfers by date to see how much you spend.
• Balance transfers require the PIN you created with *234*2*. Keep it safe.
• Combined plans (data + minutes + SMS) usually offer the best price per GB.
• The Nauta session keeps running even if you close the app: remember to log out to avoid wasting time.
• If a USSD code fails, wait a few seconds and try again; the ETECSA network limits very frequent queries."
If this app is useful to you, you can support its development with a transfer. Thank you!

UtilEs is an independent utility tool and is NOT affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by ETECSA. All trademarks and service names belong to their respective owners.

The app dials USSD codes (such as *222#, *99 or *234#) and sends SMS from your line only when you request it. Any charge applied by your operator, including balance transfers and plan purchases, is your sole responsibility. Always verify amounts and recipients before confirming an operation.

The Nauta feature signs in to the ETECSA captive portal on your behalf. Your Nauta credentials and session data are stored only on this device and are sent exclusively to the ETECSA portal. While a session remains open it consumes time from your Nauta account, even if the app is closed.

Your contacts, call history, preferences and balances are processed and stored locally on your device and are not shared with third parties. Permissions (contacts, phone, SMS, notifications, drawing over other apps) are used only for the features that need them.

If you enable call rejection or call alerts, incoming calls matching your rules will be rejected or flagged automatically. You are responsible for configuring these rules and for any missed calls that result from them.

The app is provided \"as is\", without warranties of any kind. Balances, plans and other information are parsed from operator responses and may be incomplete or out of date. The developer is not liable for damages, lost credit or lost data arising from the use of the app.
